text:
sofia: seeing a sudden spike in 502/504 from aws-west-2 origin, customers hitting timeouts. p95 latency up 3x. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: ALERT: origin-connectivity-west2 error_rate=14% threshold=5%
dan: confirmed from our side — west2 gpu pool p95 token-gen latency 1200ms -> healthy nodes getting overloaded, autoscaler not adding because nodes failing join phase
maria: traces show TLS handshake failures to CDN egress (handshake_timeout, ECONNRESET). nat-gw ips returning RST. snippet: ```TLS handshake error: remote reset by peer, tcp_reset src=34.207.XX.XX dst=10.0.2.45```
miguel: opened AWS ticket — TGW flow logs show a route table change at 2026-03-17T16:12:07Z. suspect egress ACLs or provider maintenance. tagging support now
kate: I pushed an egress restriction policy yesterday to lock down outbound ranges (trying to tighten our blast radius). rolling that back now — could be blocking CDN ASN ranges.
sofia: please confirm quick revert and then run a smoke. also starting weighted traffic shift for /v1/generate -> eu-west-1 at 10% then 30% if stable
dan: starting drain on west2 GPU pool to avoid wasting token attempts while endpoints flapping. command: ```POST https://internal-api/cluster/drain 
{
  "pool":"west2-gpu",
  "mode":"safe",
  "timeout_sec":600
}```
infra-bot: drain job started id=7890, nodes_marked=12, expected_finish=2026-03-17T16:22:00Z
kate: egress policy revert applied at 16:15 UTC. opened internal PR to allow CDN ASNs 16509/13335 (placeholder). waiting AWS confirmation
sofia: smoke tests: health check to origin via CDN returns 200 now from 3/3 probes. p50 latency back to baseline, p95 improving but still ~1.1s due to retry storms
dan: FYI shifting 30% traffic to eu-west-1 will increase cross-region egress and DB replication load. rough cost delta = ~$2k/day if sustained at this level. approving short-term for availability
miguel: AWS support replied — transient edge routing issue affecting NAT in west-2a due to provider maintenance, recommended TGW route rollback which we've avoided in favor of our revert. they will monitor.
sofia: reduced client retry from 3 -> 1 in runtime config to reduce amplification. rolling to 5% of traffic now, full rollout if stable
maria: quick mitigation checklist: 1) revert egress ACL (done), 2) traffic shift to eu-west-1 (in progress), 3) drain/evacuate flapping GPU nodes (in progress), 4) reduce retries (in progress)
dan: ongoing — starting capacity increase in backup region (eu-west-1) + provisioning burst for Dedicated pools to handle shifted load. ETA for new GPUs ~40m (standing quota check ok)
kate: will add CDN ASN wildcard to egress allowlist in infra-policy to avoid future accidental blocks. raising PR and runbook update
sofia: monitoring: adding a high-sensitivity alert for origin-connectivity to catch early TLS handshake errors. also creating short-lived dashboard for this incident
miguel: next steps: follow-up with AWS to get RCA on the maintenance window and ensure we get notifications. also schedule a small DR test for provider-side egress failures.
maria: post-incident action items: (a) add provider maintenance calendar + auto-bump route policies, (b) add CDN ASNs to baseline allowlist, (c) add automatic regional spillover policy for GPU pools. assigning owners in follow-up doc.
sofia: thanks all — will keep thread updated. marking incident as "mitigated" for now pending support confirmation and metric stabilization :thumbsup:
